items.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Debuts Limited Edition Sunday Football Sauce
items.summary: Kraft Heinz (NasdaqGS:KHC) has launched a limited edition Classico Sunday Football Sauce for the NFL season. The product connects traditional Sunday pasta meals with NFL game day viewing as a combined food and football ritual. The launch extends the Classico brand into a themed, time-bound offering aimed at football season engagement. items.title: 3 Ways to Play Unusual Options Activity in Kraft Heinz (KHC) Stock
